content.text:
**Finding submitted: deviation (high severity), Section 4.2(a) — Termination Payment.**

- **Notice mechanics (§4.1) are acceptable.** The one-year, annually auto-renewing term with either Party able to terminate on ninety (90) days' written notice sits squarely at the playbook fallback: Customer notice within the 60–90 day band, and HDI's convenience right effectively exercisable only at the end of a term on 90 days' notice. Not redlined.
- **The exit fee fails the fallback.** Section 4.2(a) charges the Company alone a Termination Payment of one half of trailing twelve-month Net Sales above $800,000 — an uncapped penalty that can dwarf the 30% revenue share we actually pay under §3.1, against a fallback cap of three months' fees. It is also drafted to apply to *any* Company termination, including one for HDI's breach.
- **Redline (validated ok:true):** capped the Termination Payment at three months' §3.1 fees and carved out terminations for HDI's breach and under §1.6 (failure to launch).
